formula: decision ~ rater + nation + language + location + (1 | judge)
notes: Fox 2016 (Applied Regression Analysis and GLMs 3e) uses the refugee-appeal data to study whether judges differ; the documented fit is a fixed-effects logistic, rendered here as a random-intercept logistic on judge per the Census fixed-blocked rule. judge is in the grouping list (10 judges, 384 cases). success is a derived nation-level logit of success rate, ignored. nation kept as a covariate (could alternatively be a crossed grouping).
